gap_fill_decisions: local reference = 1h simple mean; 'extreme' = |z| >= 2.0 (standard); 'partial reversion' = back inside 0.5 sigma (about three quarters of the way back)
outcome horizon 30 min (member of the registry set)
missing_in_source: position-sizing rule (supplied by the EUR 500 capital model of this task)
single outcome horizon (registry lists candidate sets only)
cost model (supplied by the shared harness)
name: FAST -- Intraday Mean Reversion

exits: partial reversion: on a completed 5m bar with |z| <= 0.5 exit at next open
time exit at the first 5m boundary >= entry fill + 30 min
operationalization.reference: SMA of the last 12 completed 5m closes (1h)
operationalization.rule: z = (C_t - SMA12) / std12. SHORT if z >= +2.0, LONG if z <= -2.0 (fade). Skip if std12 == 0.

source_registry.original_signal_definition: CONCEPT ONLY: a short-horizon extreme deviation from a local reference level tends to partially revert. No formula frozen.
source_registry.required_data: 1-minute canonical FX bars, derived coarser frequencies.
